{{Quote|Gorro's at the Blaster's Path. Local watering hole. Probably washing down some tonitran jerky with some Mantellian fungolager.|Qaraah|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]''</ref>}}
'''Tonitran jerky''' was a type of [[Jerky/Legends|jerky]] dish made from the meat of the [[tonitran]] lizard. Tonitran jerky was served at the [[Blaster's Path]], a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]].
